body: did you know: "cruel summer" took four years to hit no. 1. it came out on lover in 2019 and was never released as a single. then the eras tour opened with it nightly, the singalong went viral, and in october 2023 it finally topped the chart. "it's not even the summer anymore."
why: X-native (text-only) version of the Lover 'Cruel Summer' did-you-know, keeping X active a second day and filling the coldest era corner (Lover has zero prior social coverage). Trimmed to the punchiest facts: the 2019 album-track-never-a-single origin, the fast fall off the Hot 100, the Eras Tour nightly revival and viral singalong, the Oct 2023 climb to No. 1 (fifth-longest in chart history), and her 'it's not even the summer anymore' quote. Every claim traces to the Vault Lover 'Cruel Summer takes four years to become a No. 1' item (Billboard/Rolling Stone). Chart/craft lore only, outside every blocklist topic.
